responsibility: This file implements the reader for full RTL function dumps produced by GCC’s structured RTL dumping facilities. Building on the generic rtx_reader, it parses function, parameter, insn-chain, block, edge, and crtl directives; reconstructs instruction chains, source locations, MEM annotations, and CFG edges; applies deferred fixups such as insn-uid and basic-block references; and provides selftests that validate round-tripping of dumped RTL fragments and whole CFGs. Its role is whole-function RTL deserialization rather than generic single-RTX parsing.
same_name_distinction: Implements whole-function RTL deserialization from dump syntax, including parsing directives, rebuilding CFG/insn chains, and deferred fixups; read-rtl-function.h only exposes entry points to invoke that reader.
